messages:
deploybot: Scheduled change window TOMORROW 00:00 UTC — engine swap (runtime engine build q8-2026-03-18) rolling to hosted fleet. Canary 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Post here for roll / pause decisions. build_id=qbld-20260318-87

alex: ack. can we pin the dedicated pools to current stable during the rollout? want to avoid noisy neighbor regressions.

marta: yes please pin dedicated. I'll open the pin and handoff during the 23:30 preflight.

jin: quick question: what are our rollback triggers? latency p95 bump? error rate?

samir: propose rollback if: +latency p95 > 30ms (relative) for two consecutive slices (10m each) OR 2xx->5xx increase > 0.7% absolute OR inference error rate > 0.8%. also fail preflight -> abort.

alex: adding: KV cache miss ratio increase > 5% over baseline should be considered for pause.

deploybot: preflight run started by @marta at 23:30 UTC
- smoke: inproc smoke ✅
- performance sims: qps profile (staging) ✅
- kv cache test: regressions: +0.9% miss (within tolerance)
- model-compat check: pass
- canary image available: registry.redwood/runtime:q8-20260318-87

marta: preflight looks green to me. leaving notes in the release doc.

release-manager: please include the following snippet in the release notes: "Engine: runtime-q8 v2026-03-18 (build qbld-20260318-87). Notable: improved token throughput for long-context transforms; potential p95 latency regressions on <1% traffic shapes."

jin: ops checklist pasted for deploybot run:
```
deploy --image=registry.redwood/runtime:q8-20260318-87 \
  --canary=5 --canary-duration=30m \
  --stages=5,20,100 --monitor=latency,error,kv_miss
```

samir: I'm on-call for 00:00-02:00 UTC. @sre-oncall will watch infra. If we hit rollback criteria, who executes the pin/rollback?

marta: I'll trigger the rollback (I have permissions) unless sprinting on other incidents. If I'm offline, @alex will take over.

sre-oncall: I'll post infra metrics to the thread (host-level CPU/GPU saturation) and flag region-specific flaps. Also, I'll keep an eye on autoscaler churn.

deploybot: Canary 5% started at 00:00:45 UTC — canary slice id=c001 
deploybot: Canary telemetry (after 10m): p95 latency delta +12ms, error rate delta +0.05%, kv_miss delta +0.7%

alex: looks fine so far. proceed to 20% after 30m per plan.

deploybot: Scaling canary to 20% at 00:32:10 UTC — slice id=c002

deploybot: Canary telemetry (after 15m on 20%): p95 latency delta +35ms, error rate delta +0.6%, kv_miss delta +4.8%

samir: p95 > 30ms threshold hit. this meets our rollback latency trigger. Recommend pause and gather traces.

marta: pausing rollout now, marking canary as FAILED. grabbing traces from c002 and contacting runtime-team for quick triage.

jin: attaching quick trace query for the c002 window:
```sql
select trace_id, avg(duration_ms) as p95_ms from traces
where build_id='qbld-20260318-87' and canary_slice='c002'
group by trace_id
order by p95_ms desc
limit 10;
```

deploybot: canary c002 marked FAILED by @marta at 00:50:03 UTC. auto-fallback triggered: routing reverted to runtime:stable-20260301 for the 20% slice.

release-manager: rolling back to stable image across canary slices. drafting a short note: "Deployment paused — p95 latency regression observed in canary (runtime-q8 v2026-03-18). Rolling back active slices to runtime:stable-20260301. Investigating further; no customer-facing impact observed."

alex: good call. we'll add a postmortem section in the release doc with the metric diffs and GC/allocator hypothesis.

samir: opening an incident-lite for post-deploy triage, tagging runtime/quant-team and perf-analysis.

marta: re-pinning dedicated pools to runtime:stable-20260301; removing canary image from routing.

sre-oncall: infra looked stable; no autoscaler anomalies. GPU util unchanged.

jin: initial quick-diff suggests the quantized matmul kernel had increased L2 misses on certain sequence lengths. sending profiler output.

deploybot: follow-up actions:
- runtime-team: reproduce locally with qbld-20260318-87 on seq len 1024 workloads (assigned @jin)
- perf-analysis: deep trace + hotspot (assigned @alex)
- release-manager: update release notes to mark paused and link incident (assigned)
- QA: run targeted e2e with long-context prompt set (assigned @marta)

marta: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after perf triage. keeping the window closed for tonight.

release-manager: I'll send an all-hands note in the morning summarizing root cause, action items, and ETA for next attempt. :white_check_mark:
